hikes.name: Cape Lookout
hikes.blurb: Out along a narrow, forested cape two miles into the Pacific to a cliff-edge whale-watching point.

hikes.name: Cascade Head Preserve
hikes.blurb: Up steep grassy prairie on a headland above the Salmon River estuary, one of the coast's great views.

hikes.name: Harts Cove
hikes.blurb: Through old Sitka spruce to a meadow over a hidden cove where a waterfall drops into the sea.

hikes.name: Drift Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Down through coastal forest to a 240-foot suspension bridge in front of a 75-foot falls.

hikes.name: Mount Hebo
hikes.blurb: An old pioneer trail to a grassy summit looking over the coast from Cape Lookout to Cascade Head.

hikes.name: Munson Creek Falls
start: Munson Creek Falls State Natural Site
hikes.blurb: A short walk to the Coast Range's tallest falls, 319 feet in a mossy canyon.

hikes.name: Cape Meares Lighthouse
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a little lighthouse on a cliff, and to the many-trunked Octopus Tree.

hikes.name: Devil's Lake
hikes.blurb: From Extra Vehicle Parking, a 4.2-mile round trip to Devil's Lake, with about 400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: South Lake
hikes.blurb: From Pioneer-Indian Trail Tie-In - South Trailhead, a 12.9-mile round trip to South Lake, with about 2,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Beaver Point
hikes.blurb: From Munson Creek Falls Trailhead, an 11.0-mile round trip to the top of Beaver Point (2,466 ft), with about 3,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: North Lake
hikes.blurb: From Pioneer-Indian Trail Tie-In - South Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to North Lake, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pheasant Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Niagara Falls Trail Trailhead, a 1.6-mile round trip to Pheasant Creek Falls, with about 450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Forest Peak
hikes.blurb: From Lewisburg Saddle, an 11.3-mile round trip to the top of Forest Peak (1,899 ft), with about 2,600 feet of climbing.
